description: Erection of new double glazing to ground and first floor facades of hotel wing, with new south-facing window, west-facing entrance doors, and other minor elevation alterations.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access / Planning Statement, drawings OP01, OP02, OP03, OP04, OP05, OP06, OP07, and OP08 received: 14/05/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the proposed wall infill at the western entrance to the building shall match those used in the existing building.
